exercise.name: Lying Cable Curl
library_steps: Lie on your back with your feet towards a low pulley, holding a bar.
Keep your elbows by your sides and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying on the back on the floor with the feet toward a low pulley, a straight bar held palms up; the upper arms rest on the floor by the sides while the elbows bend from ~25 to ~125 deg, curling the bar to the chest. Biceps does the work, the forearms help.

setup.target: Low, past the feet; the cable runs between the knees and feet.
Resting on the floor along the sides.
setup.why: Library step: elbows by the sides.

muscles.emg: Main elbow flexor in curls (S1, S2).
muscles.role: Bends the elbow; what the exercise is for.
Helps bend the elbow; library secondary.
muscles.surface: Thumb side of the upper forearm.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arms rise toward the ceiling.

sources.citation: Marcolin G, Panizzolo FA, Petrone N, et al. 2018. Differences in electromyographic activity of biceps brachii and brachioradialis while performing three variants of curl. PeerJ 6:e5165.
sources.what_it_gave: Straight bar, EZ bar and dumbbell curls at 65 % 1RM: biceps and brachioradialis both clearly active; elbow range ~117 deg.

sources.citation: Oliveira LF, Matta TT, Alves DS, Garcia MA, Vieira TM. 2009. Effect of the shoulder position on the biceps brachii EMG in different dumbbell curls. J Sports Sci Med 8(1):24-29.
sources.what_it_gave: Standing, incline (shoulder extended) and preacher curls: biceps long head at least 50 % of max RMS in all; shoulder position shifts where in the range the biceps works hardest.

clip_check.check: Lying flat, feet flat, nothing below the floor
Both fists closed on the bar; cable between the knees to the pulley
